summary: Tested whole-page auto-translation (LangSwitcher + autoTranslate + /api/v1/i18n). Backend 21/21 pytest pass (cached translate, live LLM translate ~2.6s then persisted to dict, 422 for unsupported/en lang and >120 texts, dict seeded >2000 phrases in all 13 langs). Frontend: home page switcher shows US flag + EN, menu has all 14 options with flags (all 14 SVGs serve 200); FR/ES/DE/RU/AR translate nav, hero, banner, live-board tender titles, selects and placeholders; switching back to EN restores body text byte-for-byte; rapid switching across 11 languages caused no crash; pmc_lang persists across reload and SPA navigation; /buyers /suppliers /about /contact /trust /tenders/all /tenders/global show the flag switcher (no old globe EN button). Arabic sets dir=rtl, other langs set ltr. Vendor portal and admin Masters page translate (uncached phrases arrive in ~5s), Masters tabs keep working in Russian, typed input values untouched, input values like matrix names untouched. FOUND + FIXED: Arabic home page rendered completely BLANK (honeypot input left:-9999px caused 11,919px RTL overflow); vendor top-bar switcher label invisible (dark header without dark prop). REMAINING: /help, 8 admin pages (incl. landing Dashboard), the mobile public header and the login pages have no switcher.

minor.issue: Anyone can call it without logging in, and it can trigger LLM calls. The per-IP limit (600/min) uses the first X-Forwarded-For value, which a client can fake, so the limit is easy to get around and LLM costs could be run up. Consider a per-IP limit at the ingress or a global daily cap.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. With Arabic (dir=rtl) the home page rendered blank: the input's left:-9999px made documentElement.scrollWidth 11919px. Now hidden with width/height 1px, opacity 0 and clip-path. Verified scrollWidth is 1920 and the Arabic home page renders.

FIXED by testing agent. <LangSwitcher /> sat on the dark header without the dark prop, so the 'ES/DE' label was navy on navy and could not be seen. Changed to <LangSwitcher dark />. Label is now white.
No LangSwitcher in the header. The page does translate from the saved choice, but the user cannot change the language here.

ui_bugs.component: Admin pages with their own top bars
ui_bugs.issue: These pages build their own header (pmc-atop__r) instead of using AdminEShell, so they have no LangSwitcher: AdminDashboardE (the page admins land on after login), AdminBiddingOpsE, AdminEvaluationListE, AdminGovernanceE, AdminProgrammeE, AdminTenderBuilderE, AdminTenderReviewE, AdminVendorKycE.
The switcher is wrapped in 'hidden sm:block' and the mobile menu drawer has no switcher, so mobile users cannot change the language at all.
No LangSwitcher on the sign-in pages (they do translate from the saved choice).

issues: Longer translated nav labels push 'S'inscrire comme fournisseur' / 'Als Lieferant registrieren' about 250px past the content container's right edge (button right edge at 1826px vs 1600px). Consider a smaller gap or shorter CTA labels for long languages.

No Arabic webfont is loaded (Cormorant Garamond / Public Sans have no Arabic glyphs), so a system fallback is used. In the test container the Arabic letters showed up unjoined and widely spaced. Consider adding Noto Sans/Naskh Arabic for :lang(ar).
The headline is split across several text nodes that are translated separately, which breaks grammar ('scellé et prouvé' should agree in the plural). Same risk in other split headings.
Stays in English on public and vendor pages but is translated in admin ('Спросить PMC'). Inconsistent.

action_items: Add <LangSwitcher /> to the header of AdminDashboardE, AdminBiddingOpsE, AdminEvaluationListE, AdminGovernanceE, AdminProgrammeE, AdminTenderBuilderE, AdminTenderReviewE and AdminVendorKycE (or move them onto AdminEShell).
Add the LangSwitcher to the mobile public top bar and/or the mobile menu drawer (TopBar.jsx). Right now it is hidden below the sm breakpoint.
Add the LangSwitcher to the HelpCentreE header (/help) and, optionally, to /vendor/login and /admin/login.
Load an Arabic webfont for dir=rtl.
Fix the long-language header overflow on the public TopBar.
Harden the /i18n/translate rate limit (the X-Forwarded-For value can be faked).
critical_code_review_comments: autoTranslate.js wrap(): raw.replace(raw.trim(), tr) uses tr as a replacement pattern, so '$&', '$1' or '$$' inside a translation would be expanded. Use a function replacer instead: raw.replace(raw.trim(), () => tr).
autoTranslate.js: a failed phrase gets a 60s backoff, but nothing re-runs walk() after the backoff ends. The phrase only retries after an unrelated DOM change touches that node.
Positioning with physical left/right (e.g. left:-9999px) breaks RTL. Search for other off-screen tricks and use logical properties or clip-path.

Translating user-entered data such as staff names ('Сертификатор объекта') and tender titles matches the request, but admins may not recognise records. Consider adding translate='no' to identifiers and person-name columns.
The i18n_cache dict endpoint returns about 200KB per language (fine with Cache-Control 300s). Watch the size as the cache grows; the limit is 30,000 entries.
